## listLayout

List Layout Templates. `GET /email-templates`

List email templates for the tenant

- Can filter by category (business, creative, minimal) - Can filter by system template flag - Can filter by active status - By default excludes hidden templates (use include_hidden=true to include) - Returns list without full MJML source (for performance) - Supports pagination with limit and offset

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailTemplates()->listLayout();
```

- Scopes: `email:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Filter by category |
| `$isSystemTemplate` | `?bool` | no | Filter by system template flag |
| `$isActive` | `?bool` | no | Filter by active status |
| `$includeHidden` | `?bool` | no | Include hidden/archived templates |
| `$limit` | `?int` | no | Max results |
| `$offset` | `?int` | no | Results offset |

Returns `list<EmailLayoutTemplateList>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Templates/list_layout_templates_api_v1_email_templates_get)

## createLayout

Create Layout Template. `POST /email-templates`

Create a new email template with variable system

- Define structural framework with MJML - Use {{variable_name}} placeholders for customization - Set color palette and fonts for brand consistency - MJML is validated and compiled to HTML on creation - Variables use lowercase_with_underscores naming convention

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailTemplates()->createLayout(name: 'name', mjmlSource: 'mjml_source');
```

- Scopes: `email:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Email template name |
| `$mjmlSource` | `string` | yes | MJML source with {{variable_name}} placeholders |
| `$description` | `?string` | no | Template description |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Category (transactional, promotional, custom) |
| `$colorPalette` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Color palette (e.g., {'primary': '#0066CC'}) |
| `$fontFamily` | `?string` | no | Font family (e.g., 'Arial, sans-serif') |
| `$thumbnailUrl` | `?string` | no | Template preview thumbnail URL |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailLayoutTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Templates/create_layout_template_api_v1_email_templates_post)

## previewLayout

Preview Layout. `POST /email-templates/preview`

Preview MJML template without saving (with variable replacement)

- Accepts MJML source with {{variable}} placeholders - Replaces variables with example values - Brand variables are auto-filled from tenant settings - Compiles MJML to HTML - Returns HTML for preview - Does not save to database

## deleteLayout

Delete Layout Template. `DELETE /email-templates/{template_id}`

Delete email template

- System templates cannot be deleted - Templates with EmailContents referencing them cannot be deleted (409 Conflict) - Use this endpoint to clean up unused templates

```php

```

- Scopes: `email:delete`

## updateLayout

Update Layout Template. `PATCH /email-templates/{template_id}`

Update email template with variable system

- If MJML source is updated, recompiles to HTML - Creates new version (increments version number) - System templates cannot be modified - Template changes will affect future EmailContents using this template - Variables use {{variable_name}} syntax

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailTemplates()->updateLayout(templateId: 'template_id');
```

## duplicateLayout

Duplicate Layout Template. `POST /email-templates/{template_id}/duplicate`

Duplicate an email template

Creates a copy of the template with a new name. All content fields are copied (MJML, HTML, category, colors, thumbnail, description). The duplicate is always a non-system, non-hidden template owned by the requesting tenant.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailTemplates()->duplicateLayout(templateId: 'template_id', newName: 'new_name');
```

- Scopes: `email:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$templateId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$newName` | `string` | yes | Name for the duplicated template |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailLayoutTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Templates/duplicate_layout_template_api_v1_email_templates__template_id__duplicate_post)
